document_id: AEMET 2024 - ESTUDIO SOBRE LA SITUACIÓN DE LLUVIAS INTENSAS

times.source_text: During the morning and morning of day 31 a convective system of mesoescala (SCM31-I) affected the northern half of the province of Castellón that caused persistent precipitations of very strong intensity, locally torrential.

evidence.quote: During the morning and morning of day 31 a convective system of mesoescala (SCM31-I) affected the northern half of the province of Castellón that caused persistent precipitations of very strong intensity, locally torrential.

times.source_text: From early hours of the day there were squalls and very intense storms on the north of Castellón that spread to the south of Tarragona in the late morning.
